_note: people, extra and extraAdded are on the strict basis (same booth, name, relative, age, sex and house number, different IDs, every ID also on the 2027 roll). extraAdded = of the extra cards, those in a list of additions (where every card of a person was added, all but one count). deleted = every card on the final roll struck off with code R (पुनरावृत्ति, repeated), counted from the code alone, not matched to a surviving card. cardsAdded = all cards in the duplicate groups that sit in a list of additions, including each group's first card.
